You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From f0791b92d2b6e1bf36aed0eae93a0ef85eaa3a62 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marek Vasut <marex@denx.de>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2021 13:50:46 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] net: ks8851: Select PHYLIB and MICREL_PHY in Kconfig

The PHYLIB must be selected to provide mdiobus_*() functions, and the
MICREL_PHY is necessary too, as that is the only possible PHY attached
to the KS8851 (it is the internal PHY).

Fixes: ef3631220d2b ("net: ks8851: Register MDIO bus and the internal PHY")
Signed-off-by: Marek Vasut <marex@denx.de>
Cc: Heiner Kallweit <hkallweit1@gmail.com>
Cc: Lukas Wunner <lukas@wunner.de>
Reviewed-by: Andrew Lunn <andrew@lunn.ch>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210111125046.36326-1-marex@denx.de
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>
---
 drivers/net/ethernet/micrel/Kconfig | 4 ++++
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+)

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/micrel/Kconfig b/drivers/net/ethernet/micrel/Kconfig
index 42bc014136fe..93df3049cdc0 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/micrel/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/micrel/Kconfig
@@ -31,6 +31,8 @@ config KS8851
 	select MII
 	select CRC32
 	select EEPROM_93CX6
+	select PHYLIB
+	select MICREL_PHY
 	help
 	  SPI driver for Micrel KS8851 SPI attached network chip.
 
@@ -40,6 +42,8 @@ config KS8851_MLL
 	select MII
 	select CRC32
 	select EEPROM_93CX6
+	select PHYLIB
+	select MICREL_PHY
 	help
 	  This platform driver is for Micrel KS8851 Address/data bus
 	  multiplexed network chip.
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the absence of necessary configurations in the Kconfig file for the KS8851 driver, specifically the lack of selection for PHYLIB and MICREL_PHY. These selections are essential for providing the required mdiobus_*() functions and for recognizing the internal PHY associated with the KS8851, which is the only PHY that can be attached to it. Without these configurations, the driver would not function correctly, leading to issues in network communication.

The bug was caused by the absence of necessary configurations in the Kconfig file for the KS8851 driver, specifically the lack of selection for PHYLIB and MICREL_PHY. These selections are essential for providing the required mdiobus_*() functions and for recognizing the internal PHY associated with the KS8851, which is the only PHY that can be attached to it. Without these configurations, the driver would not function correctly, leading to issues in network communication.
